# Binance API

by Binance

REST and WebSocket API for Binance spot market data, trading and account management.

Checked against the maker's official pages, pricing on Oct 31, 2026. Tap a verdict to see its source.How we checked[Report an error](https://agentgid.com/contact/)

## What Binance API does

REST and WebSocket API for Binance spot market data, trading and account management.

- Binance API is one of 18 APIs in the Stock and financial data category on AgentGid.
- It is one of 16 that can be started for free.
- 6 of them ship an official MCP server; Binance API does not.
- Its official SDK is the 5th most downloaded in the category (16K a week).
